display.purpose: Page-level headline. Used once per view. Never on article titles.

headline.purpose: Featured article title. Most prominent story on screen.

title.purpose: Standard grid article titles. Tight tracking to preserve vertical rhythm.

body.purpose: Article summaries. Always line-clamped (2 standard, 3 featured). Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Source names, filter pills, sort toggle, metadata. Monospace + uppercase = categorical.

shadows.name: state-active
shadows.purpose: Active sort-toggle pill only. State indicator, not decorative elevation.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.value: translateY(-2px), Framer Motion spring stiffness 400 damping 30
motion.purpose: Article card hover lift. Gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: card-entrance
motion.value: opacity 0→1, y 16px→0, duration 380ms, delay i*70ms (max 500ms), ease [0.16,1,0.3,1]
motion.purpose: Staggered article card entrance. Gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: image-hover
motion.purpose: Article card image scale on card hover. Gives depth without motion in the layout.

motion.name: live-ping
motion.purpose: Nav live indicator outer ring. Signals the feed is actively updating.

components.name: Filter Pill Active
components.description: Active source or sort filter. Amber background = this filter is applied.
components.css: .ds-pill-active { background: #fbbf24; color: #09090b; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-pill-active:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Filter Pill Ghost
components.description: Inactive source filter. Zinc surface, no color.
components.css: .ds-pill-ghost { background: #27272a; color: #a1a1aa; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-pill-ghost:hover { background: #3f3f46; color: #e4e4e7; } .ds-pill-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #27272a; background: #18181b; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color 200ms, background 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #3f3f46; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-source { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; color: #71717a; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-badge-fire { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(69,10,10,0.6); color: #f87171; border: 1px solid rgba(185,28,28,0.6); font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: #e4e4e7; } .ds-card-summary { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: #71717a; line-height: 1.625; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding-top: 8px; } .ds-tags { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-tag { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #71717a; background: #27272a; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-time { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #52525b; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Nav Bar
components.description: Sticky navigation. Minimal. Backdrop blur for scroll readability.
components.html:
SIGNAL 127 articles
AI-ranked tech feed
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); background: rgba(9,9,11,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-logo-mark { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fbbf24; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-brand { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #fafafa; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-count { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #52525b; } .ds-nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-tagline { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #52525b; } .ds-live-dot { position: relative; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fbbf24; } .ds-live-dot::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fbbf24; opacity: 0.6; animation: ping 1s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Signal is a newsroom workstation, not a feed. The physical scene: a developer or founder glancing at a second monitor while compiling, wanting to know what is actually happening in tech without opening six tabs. The interface functions like a well-calibrated instrument: information present when you look, absent when you do not, never competing for the eye. Dark, precise, purposeful.

Color strategy is Restrained: near-void charcoal surfaces with a single alert-amber accent used on no more than 10% of any screen. The amber is not decorative; it signals what matters. Every appearance of amber means the same thing: pay attention to this. Its rarity is the point.

Signal explicitly rejects the consumer-magazine carousel (Flipboard, Apple News) and the noisy ad-funded news feed (TechCrunch, Mashable). The score is the only hierarchy signal that counts. Everything else recedes.
keyCharacteristics: Near-void background; content reads like ink on slate
Alert amber as a single, semantic accent with one meaning: ranked above the noise
Geist Sans for editorial weight; Geist Mono for data, counts, and metadata
Flat surfaces throughout; depth via tonal layering, never shadows

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber appears in exactly four places: virality badge (Trending tier), active filter pill, logo mark, live indicator dot. Any fifth use is a mistake. When in doubt, use zinc.

rules.name: The No-Context-Free Color Rule
rules.body: Score colors (red, orange, amber) never appear without an accompanying text label (FIRE, HOT, TRENDING, SIGNAL). Color alone cannot convey rank.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: All numbers, timestamps, and counts use Geist Mono without exception. Proportional digits in a data context break alignment and look accidental.

rules.name: The Title Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Individual article titles never exceed Headline scale. Display scale belongs to the page, not to individual stories.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow at rest. Hover and active states are expressed through border-color changes and translate transforms. If a resting element has a shadow, remove it.

dos: Do restrict amber to the four semantic uses: score badge (Trending tier), active filter pill, logo mark, live dot.
Do use Geist Mono for every number, timestamp, article count, and score.
Do express depth through tonal color shifts (Near-Void → Graphite Surface → Subtle Border). Shadows on resting elements are forbidden.
Do line-clamp article summaries (2 lines standard, 3 lines featured).
Do include the score text label alongside every score color.
Do gate all translate and scale animations behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do verify WCAG AA contrast on every new text/background pairing before shipping.
donts: Don't use a carousel, cover-photo-first layout, or horizontal scrolling story grid. These are the Flipboard and Apple News patterns.
Don't add category color tabs, author photos, engagement counts (likes, shares), or any decoration that competes with the article title. These are TechCrunch and Mashable patterns.
Don't use gradient text. Score labels are solid-color text on a tinted background.
Don't add a second accent color. The system has one: alert amber.
Don't add box-shadow to a resting card.
Don't use a border-left thicker than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't center the page headline. Left-aligned headings read as publications, not landing pages.
Don't use Inter or generic system-ui as the primary display font. Geist is the brand typeface.
